parts.label: Part 2

parts.rubric: Questions 7 – 12. Read the sentences about people. What are the missing words? The first letter is already there. There is one space for each other letter in the word. Gõ trọn vẹn từ vào ô trả lời.

qs.text: Where do you , in a flat or in a house?

parts.label: Part 3
parts.name: Vocabulary — Family and people
parts.rubric: Questions 13 – 18. Choose the word to match the picture. Write the correct letter, A – G.

parts.label: Part 4
parts.name: Reading — My sister, Yoko
parts.rubric: Questions 19 – 24. Read the text about a woman and her sister. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each space.

passage.title: My sister, Yoko
passage.html:
This is a photo of my sister, Yoko, and me. Yoko and I are Japanese. I live in Japan, but she lives in Paris, France.

Yoko (19) …… a lovely family. She is married to Pierre, from France. He speaks French and Japanese. They have two children: their son Pascal is 10 and their daughter Hana is 8. They speak two languages, too. What time (20) …… go to school? School is at 9.00 every morning. In the afternoons, Pascal plays the guitar and Hana plays football.

Yoko (21) …… to work five days a week. Where (22) …… Yoko and Pierre work? Yoko works in a big hotel in the city centre and Pierre (23) …… maths at the university near their house. What (24) …… like to do at the weekend? They like to meet friends and go to the cinema. When they are in Japan, I love to see them! And I love this photo, too.
